[{"insert":"Back Squat Progression

The final back squat of the cycle at fifteen reps per set, the highest rep count of the block. High rep squats test the legs and the will to keep pushing when tired. Brace hard at the top of every rep and hold the same depth and speed on rep fifteen as on rep one. Aim to beat Week 4 across all working sets.
"}]
